links.outcome: Reading grade level of ChatGPT responses to glaucoma FAQs versus Google
links.effect: ChatGPT responses averaged grade 14.3 vs Google 9.4 (p<0.001); FRE 35.2 vs 53.0; procedure explanations grade 16.6 when unspecified.
links.quote: ChatGPT responses to patient FAQs were written at a significantly higher average grade level than Google responses (14.3 vs 9.4, respectively, p < 0.001) ( Table 2 ).

links.outcome: Reading level of ChatGPT procedure explanations when a seventh-grade level was requested
links.effect: Average grade level fell from 16.6 to 9.4 and FRE rose from 33.1 to 67.4 (p<0.001); expert-rated inaccuracy 19.0% vs 28.6% (p=0.47).
links.quote: When instructed to generate education materials at a seventh grade reading level, readability significantly improved to an average grade level of 9.4 and an FRE of 67.4 (“standard”) ( p < 0.001).

links.outcome: Expert-rated inaccuracy of ChatGPT versus Google responses to glaucoma FAQs
links.effect: Google responses contained inaccurate or inappropriate information 23% of the time vs 3% for ChatGPT (p<0.001); three glaucoma specialists rated blinded responses.
links.quote: Google responses were rated to contain inaccurate or inappropriate information 23% of the time while ChatGPT responses contained inaccurate or inappropriate information 3% of the time ( p < 0.001).

unlisted_practices: Prompting an LLM to write at a specified reading level to tailor patient education materials

links.quote: Google responses were rated to contain inaccurate or inappropriate information 23% of the time while ChatGPT responses contained inaccurate or inappropriate information 3% of the time ( p < 0.001).

links.effect: ChatGPT average grade level 14.3 vs Google 9.4; p < 0.001.
links.quote: ChatGPT responses to patient FAQs were written at a significantly higher average grade level than Google responses (14.3 vs 9.4, respectively, p < 0.001) ( Table 2 ).

links.effect: Reading level fell grade 16.6 to 9.4 (p < 0.001) without reducing accuracy.
links.quote: When instructed to revise glaucoma procedural explanations to improve understandability, ChatGPT reduced the average reading level of educational materials from grade 16.6 (college level) to grade 9.4 (high school level) (p < 0.001) without reducing the accuracy of procedural explanations.

links.effect: Experts correctly identified AI-generated FAQ responses 39.5% (34/86).
links.quote: Among the responses that experts attempted to identify, 39.5% (34/86) were correctly identified as the AI-generated response ( Table 5 ).
